entries.en: to be linked, tied; to follow one another in succession
wheel, rotation; to take turns, follow in rotation
to succeed, inherit; to continue (a line), as the son after the father
to join, link; to follow in unbroken succession
to go wrong, miscarry; downfall, ruin
entries.notes: 汉字栏两读「傾/頃」存疑，取「傾」以合「Suceder mal」倾覆之义。

entries.en: to meet with adversity, fare ill (as in 迍邅)
to suffer misfortune, meet with adversity

entries.zh: 活人行死路（活人自走死路，自蹈危亡）
entries.en: a living man walking the road of death (rushing into mortal peril)
entries.notes: M 栏音符有一处 T99 污损，仅涉声调符号，字面四栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 有结尾（有收场；结局良好）
entries.en: to end well; to have a (good) ending

entries.zh: 圣杯／圣筊（掷筊问神，得吉兆允准）
entries.en: favorable omen; the sacred divination blocks answering well
entries.notes: 汉字录作「聖枉」，与 M「pue」及西语「bien/fuerte」不合，疑为「聖杯」之误识，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 择替（选派接替，顶替职任）
entries.en: to choose a replacement, succeed to an office
entries.notes: 西语缩写 of°（=oficio）及「mo la gente finela」残浊难通读，据 H/M 与大意补足；M「pay」与字「擇」不合，疑为「派」。

entries.zh: 应兆（兆头应验，感应其兆）
entries.en: for an omen to be fulfilled; to answer a portent
entries.notes: 西语「como lo Sosso」难确解，据 H「應兆」/M「eng siau」释义。

entries.zh: 圣签（神庙抽签之签，占问吉凶之兆）
entries.en: sacred divination lot (stick drawn as an omen)

entries.zh: 传继（传嗣继业；子承父任）
entries.en: to pass on and continue (an inheritance/line); the son succeeding the father
to take turns by the day; day following day
to take turns, alternate in rotation
entries.notes: M 栏多记「aue cy」两音节，与二字头不合，照录存查，不碍释义。

entries.en: to choose a replacement, change over in an office
entries.notes: 西语「Suceder de en of°」缩写残句难通读，据 H「擇換」/M「pay va」释义。

entries.zh: 相继勿绝（前后相承，不可断绝）
entries.en: to succeed one another without interruption, continue unbroken

entries.zh: 承接（接续承当，前后相承）
entries.en: to take over and carry on; to receive and continue

entries.zh: 相轮守更（轮流值更守夜）
entries.en: to take turns keeping the night watch

entries.zh: 铁纱帽（铁打的乌纱帽；官职牢固，子继父任）
entries.en: an iron official's hat (a secure, hereditary post; the son succeeding the father in office)
entries.notes: 西语栏长句残浊难通读（「sucesnefe」等），大意谓子继父任于官府，与「铁纱帽」牢固官帽之喻对应，系推断释义。

entries.en: to continue, renew
entries.notes: 西语栏空缺，据汉字「續」与 M「sion」释义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅存西语残词「Sucenoy（疑为 Suceda）」，汉字与注音栏全空，无从释义。
